example.title: Bank Block, Water Street (John Margolies Roadside America photo)

brief: Two-storey Richardsonian Romanesque corner bank block in dark brown brick with brownstone trim: a rounded corner tower rising above the roofline with a crenellated brick crown, a lettered name band and a green copper conical cap with a tall spike. Upper windows in continuous round-arched arcades with brick hood moulds; a corbelled cornice. The angled corner entrance sits under a carved stone lintel on a squat column; rock-faced stone base and a few plain storefront openings along the side street.
